identificationModule.briefTitle: Study to Assess Efficacy and Safety of HSK39297 Tablets in Patients With LN
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled Phase II Clinical Trial to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of HSK39297 Tablets in Patients With Lupus Nephritis

descriptionModule.briefSummary: A double-blind,placebo controlled,randomized Phase 2 study to evaluate the safety and tolerability of once-daily, oral administration of 200 or 300 mg HSK39297 tablets versus placebo in Patients With Lupus Nephritis

armGroups.label: 200mg QD
armGroups.description: Patients take double-blind HSK39297 tablets 200mg for 52 weeks

armGroups.label: 300mg QD
armGroups.description: Patients take double-blind HSK39297 tablets 300mg for 52 weeks

armGroups.label: Placebo
armGroups.description: Patients take double-blind placebo for 52 weeks

interventions.name: HSK39297 200mgQD
interventions.description: once daily, oral administration of HSK39297 tablets 200mg from Day 1 to Week 52.

interventions.name: HSK39297 300mgQD
interventions.description: once daily, oral administration of HSK39297 tablets 300mg from Day 1 to Week 52.

interventions.name: Placebo
interventions.description: once daily, oral administration of placebo from Day 1 to Week 52.

secondaryOutcomes.description: FACIT-F scale ranges from 0 to 52 score,and the higher scores indicate a better condition of the subject and less fatigue.
